<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Natural Conduit](/Feats.aspx?ID=5409) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Ranger" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=682" />
<trait label="Spellshape" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=513" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 59

**Prerequisites**
warden spells

**Requirements**
You have line of effect to your animal companion or another [friendly](/Conditions.aspx?ID=75) [animal](/Traits.aspx?ID=531) within 60 feet.

</column>

---

You can use an animal as a conduit for your magic. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, the spell uses the animal as its origin point.
